title: Premium seats are coming to ChatGPT Business
summary: Premium seats are now available on ChatGPT Business, with 5x more usage, no five-hour usage limit, and flexible seat options for every teammate.
body: Premium seats are now available on ChatGPT Business, with 5x more usage, no five-hour usage limit, and flexible seat options for every teammate.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布为ChatGPT Business推出高级席位，提供更高的使用限额和更灵活的配置选项。此举旨在提升企业用户的服务体验，属于商业化运营范畴。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于企业级产品的功能更新，不涉及模型技术层面的实质性进展。
